A '''battle''' at Centares was fought between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], and [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]].

After the death of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Zsinj]] in the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|battle]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], Teradoc, Ackbar, and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] moved into Zsinj's former territory to capture what they could. After Teradoc's major defeats at [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] and [[Thanos]], Admiral Ackbar attacked Teradoc's territory and its capital, [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].
